howto.name: Choose a direction
howto.text: Switch between YAML to TOML and TOML to YAML depending on the config format you need.

howto.name: Paste config
howto.text: Common nested maps, strings, numbers, booleans, and arrays are parsed directly in your browser.

howto.name: Copy converted output
howto.text: Use the converted config in pyproject.toml, Cargo.toml, app config, or deployment files.

faq.q: Are YAML anchors and custom tags supported?
faq.a: No. The converter is designed for common app config: nested maps, strings, numbers, booleans, and simple arrays.
No. Comments are omitted during conversion because TOML and YAML comments do not map cleanly through a simple object representation.
No. Conversion runs locally in your browser.
